#!/usr/bin/env bash
# backup.sh - make a dated, compressed copy of a directory and prune old ones.
# Fixture for the token estimator tests: a typical maintenance script.

set -euo pipefail
IFS=$'\n\t'

readonly SCRIPT_NAME="$(basename "$0")"
readonly DEFAULT_KEEP=7

usage() {
  cat <<EOF
Usage: $SCRIPT_NAME [-k days] [-n] <source-dir> <backup-dir>

  -k days   how many daily archives to keep (default: $DEFAULT_KEEP)
  -n        dry run: print what would be done
  -h        show this help
EOF
}

log()  { printf '%s [%s] %s\n' "$(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)" "$1" "$2" >&2; }
die()  { log ERROR "$1"; exit "${2:-1}"; }

keep="$DEFAULT_KEEP"
dry_run=false

while getopts ':k:nh' opt; do
  case "$opt" in
    k) keep="$OPTARG" ;;
    n) dry_run=true ;;
    h) usage; exit 0 ;;
    :) die "option -$OPTARG needs an argument" 2 ;;
    \?) die "unknown option: -$OPTARG" 2 ;;
  esac
done
shift $((OPTIND - 1))

[[ $# -eq 2 ]] || { usage; exit 2; }
src="${1%/}"
dest="${2%/}"

[[ -d "$src" ]] || die "source directory not found: $src"
[[ "$keep" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || die "-k expects a number, got '$keep'"
command -v tar >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "tar is not installed"

stamp="$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
archive="$dest/$(basename "$src")-$stamp.tar.gz"
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT

run() {
  if "$dry_run"; then
    echo "[dry-run] $*"
  else
    "$@"
  fi
}

log INFO "backing up $src -> $archive"
run mkdir -p "$dest"
run tar --exclude='*.tmp' --exclude='node_modules' -czf "$tmp/archive.tar.gz" -C "$(dirname "$src")" "$(basename "$src")"
run mv "$tmp/archive.tar.gz" "$archive"

if ! "$dry_run"; then
  size="$(du -h "$archive" | cut -f1)"
  sum="$(sha256sum "$archive" | awk '{print $1}')"
  echo "$sum  $(basename "$archive")" >> "$dest/SHA256SUMS"
  log INFO "wrote $archive ($size, sha256 ${sum:0:12}...)"
fi

# Prune archives older than $keep days.
mapfile -t old < <(find "$dest" -maxdepth 1 -name "$(basename "$src")-*.tar.gz" -mtime +"$keep" | sort)
if (( ${#old[@]} > 0 )); then
  log INFO "removing ${#old[@]} archive(s) older than $keep days"
  for f in "${old[@]}"; do
    run rm -f -- "$f"
  done
else
  log INFO "nothing to prune"
fi

free_kb="$(df -Pk "$dest" | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')"
if (( free_kb < 1048576 )); then
  log WARN "less than 1 GiB free on $(df -P "$dest" | awk 'NR==2 {print $6}')"
fi

log INFO "done"
